items.title: PDD drops as Morgan Stanley cuts to Equalweight on capital return risks
items.summary: Investing.com -- PDD Holdings Inc DRC (NASDAQ:PDD) dropped 3.2% in Monday trading after Morgan Stanley stepped to the sidelines on the Chinese e-commerce operator, citing mounting uncertainty over capital allocation. Analyst Eddy Wang downgraded the stock to Equalweight from Overweight and reduced the firm’s base-case price target to $90 from $129, pointing to an absence of clarity around shareholder returns.

items.title: Morgan Stanley to bolster IPO wheelhouse with Vinyl acquisition
items.summary: Financial terms of the Vinyl Equity deal were not disclosed. But the purchase gives the bank an in-house transfer agent for share transfer, which can be complicated when a company goes public.
